profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer at Kind Lending, LLC
profile.summary: Software Developer with 10+ years’ experience in design, development, and deployment of custom business applications in the mortgage industry. I am fairly adept at SQL Server database development and management. And, I bring 25+ years in the mortgage technology field.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Santa Ana, California, United States · Remote
positions.description: Responsible for the development and maintenance of software related to third party integrations.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for the development, testing, and maintenance of business critical applications related to mortgage technology.

Designed and developed a priority queue application for Underwriting and Doc Drawers allowing our users to efficiently manage their loan pipelines based on a complex set of rules and conditions.

Designed, developed, and deployed a private environment within Azure.  Each resource designed to serve one purpose and completely unaware of other resources, resulting in a highly reliable, maintainable, and expandable infrastructure.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Core · Visual Studio · Blazor · Microsoft Azure · Azure SQL · Azure DevOps Services · Azure Functions · .NET Framework · K2 · Microsoft SQL Server · Encompass

company.name: Paramount Residential Mortgage Group Inc. (PRMG Inc.)

positions.title: Sr. Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for the design and development of API’s related to loan servicing and loan origination.  Using the latest tools in cloud development, I help build and maintain the business tools required for the ever changing mortgage industry.

Successfully developed a service that integrates the communication between our local servicing and originations platforms to the Salesforce cloud storage.  This service allowed our marketing team to utilize the Sales Cloud and Marketing Cloud for their campaigns.

Successfully developed an API that integrates the communication between our local originations platform to the Desktop Underwriter service for Fannie Mae, replacing the current method, which involved packaging our information to a third party proprietary software.  Doing this allowed for more flexibility within the automated underwriting techniques, and gave us the freedom to tailor the DU services to our needs.

Developed a service for propagating local data to our third party host, needed for tracking and presenting daily, monthly, and yearly reporting numbers.  This service replaced a manual reporting process, which involved constant maintenance of the reporting structure.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft SQL Server · Microsoft Azure · .NET Framework · Visual Studio · .NET Core

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Primary responsibilities include the design and development of multi-tiered applications geared toward mortgage loan origination.  Using C#, ASP.NET, and a SQL back-end for data storage, I helped build front-end web applications, web services, and windows services, helping the company maintain efficient business workflow processes.

Part of a team to successfully migrate from an aging LOS (Loan Origination System) to a new LOS, allowing the company to continue business through mandatory, regulatory changes.

Contributed to the design and development of a customer facing web portal, helping our customers manage and maintain loan applications effectively and efficiently.

Designed and developed an integration portal, necessary to supplement the use of our loan origination system, eliminating a significant amount of manual work for our users.

Designed and developed Windows services, used for continuous synchronization between our LOS and third-party software, allowing for two disparate systems to perform as one.

Designed and developed integration software for the delivery of data to third-party and government agencies, allowing our users to deliver loan data and receive automated results instantly.

As the interim Database Administrator, I maintained several SQL Server Databases including our primary loan origination and document imaging software.

Performed duties as network engineer, which included the design and maintenance of LAN, WAN, Firewall, and VPN communications.

Performed duties as a security admin, which included the maintenance of Exchange and Active Directory.

positions.title: Business Software Analyst
positions.description:
Primary responsibilities include the support and administration of the company’s loan origination software

Performed training and provided manuals related to the loan origination software.

Re-designed the current methods in which wiring funds were performed

positions.title: Information Technology Manager
positions.description:
Successfully transitioned from an aging origination software to a new origination software, allowing the company to take advantage of leading edge technology and workflows, while providing the foundation for scalability in future design.

Facilitated in the move of our corporate office from one location to another, allowing for the smooth turn-up of all systems the following day.

Designed and implemented the overhaul of corporate infrastructure using MS Cluster Services and Citrix Metaframe, allowing for the easy deployment of mainstream applications to remote users without the need for hardware.

Designed and implemented a disaster recovery plan, allowing the company to function with piece of mind.

Designed and implemented VPN technology needed to connect 9 remote branches, greatly increasing their ability to communicate with our corporate network.
